subject.title: Windows QuickStart defaults first chat to paid Anthropic model without credit warning

question: For Anthropic first-run setup, should OpenClaw change the default model, add a billing/readiness preflight warning, improve first-chat error recovery, or combine these?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the permanent fix changes provider default, setup warning, or billing-readiness policy for new users and could affect intentional Anthropic Opus setups.

options.title: Add provider-owned readiness warning
options.body: Warn before hatch when Anthropic setup selects an Opus/API-key path without evidence that billing or credits are ready, while preserving existing configured defaults.

options.title: Change first-run Anthropic default
options.body: Move new Anthropic onboarding to a lower-cost default model, accepting the model-quality and compatibility tradeoff as an intentional product change.

options.title: Improve recovery only
options.body: Keep the Opus default and make first-chat billing failures explicitly say setup succeeded and provider billing needs action.

recommendation.title: Add provider-owned readiness warning
recommendation.body: Warn before hatch when Anthropic setup selects an Opus/API-key path without evidence that billing or credits are ready, while preserving existing configured defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the commit that intentionally moved Anthropic's default to Opus and the related setup wizard surface history.
